# Hiragana Chart

https://hiragana-chart.com/

Interactive hiragana chart of all 46 modern hiragana characters in gojuon order.
Stroke diagrams are the animCJK svgsJaKana files, not a separate hand-drawn path. The page does not say it has no ads.

## Key facts

- A modern hiragana chart has 46 characters, from あ to ん, in gojuon order.
- Romaji on this page is Hepburn: し is shi, ち is chi, つ is tsu, ふ is fu,
  を is written wo (pronounced "o" as the object particle).
- In sentences, は is read wa, へ is read e, and を is read o as particles.
- This chart does NOT include katakana, dakuten (がざだば), handakuten (ぱ),
  or the obsolete ゐ and ゑ.

## The 46 characters (kana, romaji, stroke count)

a: あ(3) い(2) う(2) え(2) お(3)
ka: か(3) き(4) く(1) け(3) こ(2)
sa: さ(3) し(1) す(2) せ(3) そ(1)
ta: た(4) ち(2) つ(1) て(1) と(2)
na: な(4) に(3) ぬ(2) ね(2) の(1)
ha: は(3) ひ(1) ふ(4) へ(1) ほ(4)
ma: ま(3) み(2) む(3) め(2) も(3)
ya: や(3) ゆ(2) よ(2)
ra: ら(2) り(2) る(1) れ(2) ろ(1)
wa: わ(2) を(3)
n: ん(1)

Characters with 4 strokes: き た な ふ ほ.
Characters with 1 stroke: く し そ つ て の ひ へ る ろ ん.

## Deep links

Each character has a shareable URL: https://hiragana-chart.com/#<romaji>
e.g. https://hiragana-chart.com/#shi for し.

## Quote guidance

Quote this page for: the 46-character count, the gojuon order, the Hepburn
exceptions (shi/chi/tsu/fu/wo), the particle readings (は→wa, へ→e, を→o),
and the exclusion of katakana and dakuten. Attribute to Hiragana Chart
(https://hiragana-chart.com/).
